description: `--page 2` on a paged listing: pages are cursors, so the suggestion lists the first page and the Action names result.nextBefore. (JSON envelope)

problem.action: List the first page with `prose --output json cli run list`, then pass its result.nextBefore to --before for the next page.

details.reason: unknown option --page for `cli run list`; pages are cursors, not numbers: --before takes the result.nextBefore of the previous page
